# 1 Samuel Chapter 8 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 8

---

### Verse 1
- **EMET:** "And-it-was when was-old Samuel, and-he-appointed his-sons [as] judges for-Israel."
- **LOGOS:** "And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he appointed his sons as judges over Israel."
- **PNEUMA:** "When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as judges over Israel."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-was [the]-name of-his-son, the-firstborn, Joel, and-[the]-name of-his-second, Abijah -- judges in-Beer-sheba."
- **LOGOS:** "And the name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; they were judging in Beer-sheba."
- **PNEUMA:** "His firstborn was named Joel, and his second, Abijah. They served as judges in Beersheba."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "And-was-evil the-thing in-[the]-eyes of-Samuel when they-said, \"Give to-us a-king to-judge-us.\" And-prayed Samuel unto YHWH."
- **LOGOS:** "And the matter was evil in the eyes of Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." And Samuel prayed to the LORD."
- **PNEUMA:** "This demand deeply troubled Samuel — especially the words "Give us a king to govern us." So Samuel prayed to the LORD."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-said YHWH unto Samuel, \"Listen to-[the]-voice of-the-people in-all which they-say unto-you, for not you have-they-rejected, but me they-have-reje..."
- **LOGOS:** "And the LORD said to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you, for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me..."
- **PNEUMA:** "And the LORD told Samuel, "Listen to everything the people are saying to you. They are not rejecting you — they are rejecting me as their king."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "According-to-all the-deeds which they-have-done from-the-day I-brought-them-up from-Egypt and-unto this-day -- and-they-forsook-me and-they-served god..."
- **LOGOS:** "According to all the deeds that they have done, from the day I brought them up from Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served o..."
- **PNEUMA:** "This is what they have always done, from the day I brought them out of Egypt until now — abandoning me and serving other gods. And now they are doing ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 9
- **EMET:** "And-now listen to-their-voice; however, you-shall-surely-warn them, and-you-shall-declare to-them [the]-manner of-the-king who will-reign over-them.\""
- **LOGOS:** "Now therefore, listen to their voice; however, you shall solemnly warn them and declare to them the manner of the king who will reign over them.""
- **PNEUMA:** "So listen to their demand. But give them a solemn warning. Make absolutely clear to them what a king will do to them.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-said Samuel all [the]-words of-YHWH unto the-people, the-ones-asking from-him a-king."
- **LOGOS:** "And Samuel spoke all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking a king from him."
- **PNEUMA:** "Samuel relayed every word the LORD had spoken to the people who were demanding a king."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 11
- **EMET:** "And-he-said, \"This will-be [the]-manner of-the-king who will-reign over-you: your-sons he-will-take and-he-will-set [them] for-himself in-his-chariot..."
- **LOGOS:** "And he said, "This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: your sons he will take and appoint for himself, for his chariots and for hi..."
- **PNEUMA:** "He said, "This is how a king will rule over you: He will take your sons and assign them to his chariots and cavalry, and they will run ahead of his ch..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 12
- **EMET:** "And-to-set for-himself commanders of-thousands and-commanders of-fifties, and-to-plow his-plowing and-to-reap his-harvest, and-to-make his-instruments..."
- **LOGOS:** "And he will appoint for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and some to plow his plowing and to reap his harvest, and to make h..."
- **PNEUMA:** "He will appoint them as his commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties. Some will plow his fields and harvest his crops. Others will make his w..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 15
- **EMET:** "And-your-seed and-your-vineyards he-will-tithe, and-he-will-give to-his-officers and-to-his-servants."
- **LOGOS:** "And your seed-crops and your vineyards he will tithe, and he will give to his officers and to his servants."
- **PNEUMA:** "He will take a tenth of your grain and your vintage and give it to his officers and attendants."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 17
- **EMET:** "Your-flocks he-will-tithe, and-you -- you-will-be to-him as-servants."
- **LOGOS:** "Your flocks he will tithe, and you yourselves will become his servants."
- **PNEUMA:** "He will take a tenth of your flocks. And you yourselves will become his slaves."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 19
- **EMET:** "And-refused the-people to-listen to-[the]-voice of-Samuel, and-they-said, \"No! But a-king shall-be over-us."
- **LOGOS:** "But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel, and they said, "No! Rather, a king shall be over us,"
- **PNEUMA:** "The people refused to listen to Samuel. "No!" they said. "We want a king over us,"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 20
- **EMET:** "And-we-will-be, also we, like-all the-nations, and-shall-judge-us our-king, and-he-will-go-out before-us and-he-will-fight our-battles.\""
- **LOGOS:** "and we also shall be like all the nations, and our king will judge us and go out before us and fight our battles.""
- **PNEUMA:** "so that we can be like all the other nations, with a king to govern us and lead us out to fight our battles.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 21
- **EMET:** "And-heard Samuel all [the]-words of-the-people, and-he-spoke-them in-[the]-ears of-YHWH."
- **LOGOS:** "And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he spoke them in the ears of the LORD."
- **PNEUMA:** "Samuel listened to everything the people said and reported it all back to the LORD."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 22
- **EMET:** "And-said YHWH unto Samuel, \"Listen to-their-voice and-you-shall-make-reign for-them a-king.\" And-said Samuel unto [the]-men of-Israel, \"Go, each-ma..."
- **LOGOS:** "And the LORD said to Samuel, "Listen to their voice and make a king reign over them." And Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Go, each man to his city...."
- **PNEUMA:** "The LORD said to Samuel, "Do as they ask. Give them a king." Then Samuel told the men of Israel, "Go home, each of you to your own town.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
